pages.text: $(thing)Right-click$() your companion to open their screen (owner only).$(br)On the right side:$(li)$(thing)Stance$(): cycles between $(l:epicvanguard:commanding/stances)Follow, Guard and Stay$().$(li)$(thing)Stop$(): ends the current fight and clears the target.$(li)Three $(thing)tactic buttons$(), explained on the next page.

pages.title: Tactics
pages.text: Lit buttons are on, grey ones are off.$(li)$(thing)Sword$(): attack hostile monsters. Off for new recruits.$(li)$(thing)Meat$(): hunt adult animals for food.$(li)$(thing)Hand$(): pick up items from the ground. On by default; they never take items you dropped yourself.

pages.title: Tabs and Name
pages.text: The $(thing)Backpack$() tab shows their gear and health; the $(thing)Talents$() tab shows their level, XP and class bonuses.$(br2)To rename a companion, press the $(thing)pencil$(), use a named $(item)Name Tag$() on them, or the $(l:epicvanguard:reference/commands)rename command$().
